build_coco_split_dataset: build a CocoSplitDataset instance with train_class and eval_class splits for open-world object proposal training
load_annotations_coco_split: load COCO annotation file into a CocoSplitDataset and map category IDs for training and evaluation splits
filter_imgs_coco_split: filter images in CocoSplitDataset to exclude those without ground truth annotations for the training category split
parse_ann_info_coco_split: parse bounding box and mask annotations from COCO format into numpy arrays for the training category subset
evaluate_coco_split: evaluate detection results on a CocoSplitDataset using COCO metrics with cross-category evaluation and class-agnostic support
